title: Operational check value
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, let a table assign a Boolean function to each vertex, and fix a vertex and a sign query check. Independently choose a uniformly random neighbor of that vertex for each input position of the check; the operational check value is the probability that the check's predicate accepts the resulting neighbor responses from the table.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game $G$ with alphabet size $q$
A table of Boolean functions indexed by vertices
